reels.title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper perfectly combines high-velocity 'robotics_tamp' (1.18x) with 'hardware_efficiency' concepts (reducing token overhead), addressing the common viewer complaint about slow/expensive AI agents.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your robot could think 65% faster by simply forgetting what doesn't matter?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A professional chef preparing a meal by ignoring the clutter on the counter and focusing only on the ingredients that actually end up in the pan.
